missing: Empty strings mean unavailable metadata or structurally absent evidence; complete zero citation counts are observed. R estimates may use NA for unavailable uncertainty. All identifiers are strings.

source_id.meaning: Identifier for a catalog listing; not an original article or unique file.

catalog_url.meaning: Catalog page establishing inclusion in the inventory.

url.meaning: Source or download URL; no authentication credentials.

title.meaning: Catalog or bibliographic title; candidate titles may remain unresolved.

journal.meaning: Journal name from catalog or verified metadata.

status.meaning: Stage-specific observed disposition; see values and the construction contract.

document_id.meaning: Identifier for a source-linked file; duplicate contents can have different IDs.

name.meaning: Source-provided document filename or linked_fulltext placeholder.

format.meaning: Filename-derived document format; unknown when not inferred.

created_at.meaning: Provider creation timestamp; does not establish public disclosure.

modified_at.meaning: Provider modification timestamp; does not establish public disclosure.

date_meaning.meaning: Explicit interpretation of the accompanying source timestamp.

detail.meaning: Retrieval error or diagnostic detail; empty for successful retrieval.

sha256.meaning: SHA-256 content checksum of retrieved bytes.

path.meaning: Repository-relative cache path; private raw contents are not redistributed.

retrieved_at.meaning: UTC retrieval timestamp from cached response provenance.

stated_date.meaning: Date recorded by source provider, with meaning in date_meaning.

original_title_hint.meaning: Catalog-supplied original title; an identity hint.

related_source_id.meaning: Explicitly linked discussion-paper ID; empty for other external links.

relation.meaning: Meaning of a source-to-source or source-to-article relationship.

article_id.meaning: Opaque original-article identity; title-derived for registry, OpenAlex ID for controls.

doi.meaning: Normalized original-article DOI; empty if unresolved.

openalex_id.meaning: Full OpenAlex work URL for resolved identity.

journal_id.meaning: OpenAlex journal/source URL used for exact journal matching.

publication_date.meaning: Earliest publication date reported in the accepted Crossref record; may be later than online-first. Conservative age gate; no outcome-derived dates.

type.meaning: OpenAlex-compatible document type; primary outcomes count article and review.

abstract.meaning: Original-article abstract text where supplied by OpenAlex; blank uses title-only matching.

identity_verified.meaning: yes only after accepted bibliographic match; pending otherwise.

retracted.meaning: Current indexed retraction flag: yes, no or unknown; not a historical treatment indicator.

retraction_date.meaning: Earliest known retraction date from dated notice ledger.

metadata_sha256.meaning: Checksum of the raw accepted bibliographic response.

alias.meaning: Superseded title-derived ID mapping to canonical article_id.

evidence.meaning: Source pointer or documented identity/link decision.

review_status.meaning: Depth/disposition of source reading; not a verified error label.

classification.meaning: Reviewer classification or candidate description; unresolved is not a negative finding.

target_title.meaning: Reviewer-identified original-paper title, pending identity resolution.

evidence_summary.meaning: Paraphrased evidence supporting a candidate assessment, including limitations.

evidence_pages.meaning: Source-reader locations; preserve stated PDF/printed page distinction.

review_scope.meaning: Reviewer limitations and what was examined.

related_sources.meaning: Semicolon-separated linked source IDs or reviewer cross-references.

assessment_eligibility.meaning: yes/no/unresolved: whether the source is an eligible article-specific assessment for the coverage denominator.

assessment_resolved.meaning: yes/no: explicit final adjudication for the coverage gate; default no.

assessment_id.meaning: Identifier for a particular article-specific error assessment.

category.meaning: Type of error or broader concern; primary cohort requires demonstrated material error.

material.meaning: yes/no/unresolved: whether the documented error materially changes a substantive finding.

error_verified.meaning: yes, pending_second_review or unresolved; only yes enters verified-error cohort.

affected_claim.meaning: Substantive result affected; does not imply every finding in the article fails.

evidence_locator.meaning: Public source and page/table/section identifying the error and consequence.

dispute_status.meaning: Author acknowledgment, response, dispute or unresolved status.

verification_scope.meaning: Evidence actually checked; source verification is distinct from re-running code.

public_year.meaning: Known public assessment year for time-aware control exclusions.

event_id.meaning: Identifier for a candidate particular-error disclosure event.

warning_id.meaning: Shared disclosure identifier for dependence when one warning affects multiple articles.

date.meaning: Disclosure date in events/claims, retraction date in retractions; blank when exact day unknown.

year.meaning: Public disclosure year in events; observed citation year in citation/panel tables.

date_precision.meaning: day/month/year: precision supported by public evidence.

publicity_verified.meaning: yes only when public timing has a documented source.

date_evidence.meaning: Reasoning for earliest substantiated public year/day and unresolved earlier versions.

already_retracted.meaning: Retraction status at disclosure: no required for primary cohort.

notice_doi.meaning: Normalized DOI of the retraction notice.

dataset_url.meaning: Public dataset supplying the dated retraction record.

control_id.meaning: Original control-article ID retained across reused matches.

rank.meaning: Distance order within event/horizon; 1 is closest; stable ID breaks ties.

distance.meaning: Standardized pre-citation and text matching distance; no post outcomes used.

weight.meaning: Treated article weight 1; selected controls total 1 per stack.

horizon.meaning: Full calendar years after disclosure, primary 1; secondary 2 and 3.

eligible.meaning: yes/no after metadata, age, exposure and citation-caliper gates.

reason.meaning: Explicit exclusion reason; blank if eligible.

pre2_smd.meaning: Control minus treated log1p citations in year -2, divided by pooled risk-set SD.

pre1_smd.meaning: Control minus treated log1p citations in year -1, divided by pooled risk-set SD.

change_smd.meaning: Standardized difference in the two-year pre-citation log change.

text_cosine_distance.meaning: One minus title/abstract TF-IDF cosine similarity.

stack_id.meaning: Identifier for a matched event/horizon or sensitivity comparison.

event_time.meaning: Calendar year relative to disclosure; zero omitted from primary estimation.

treated.meaning: 1 for affected original article; 0 for matched control.

post.meaning: 1 for after period, 0 for before period; placebo period coding follows comparison order.

citations.meaning: Deduplicated citing journal articles/reviews; sensitivity averages may be fractional.

specification.meaning: Named sensitivity comparison; see design and construction ledger.

disclosure_date.meaning: Exact public-disclosure date when known, otherwise blank.

citing_work_id.meaning: OpenAlex work ID of the citing publication.

citing_doi.meaning: Normalized DOI of the citing publication; absent uses work ID for deduplication.

candidates.meaning: Number of raw works returned by a complete journal/type/cohort risk-set query.

articles.meaning: Distinct original articles in the fitted comparison.

affected_articles.meaning: Distinct treated articles in the fitted comparison.

disclosure_events.meaning: Distinct shared disclosure warnings used for clustering.

estimate.meaning: Equal-treated-weight matched change in citing publications.

lower.meaning: Lower limit of two-sided 95% t interval; NA if unavailable.

upper.meaning: Upper limit of two-sided 95% t interval; NA if unavailable.

inference.meaning: Variance convention or reason inference unavailable.

median.meaning: Weighted lower median citations in group-period.

distinct_articles.meaning: Distinct original article IDs in group-period.

provider.meaning: Accepted bibliographic provider: crossref or openalex.

alias_openalex_id.meaning: Known OpenAlex work alias of a canonical control article; incoming edges are combined across aliases.

query_filter.meaning: Exact OpenAlex risk-set filter; must agree with current treated metadata before matching.

canonical_source_id.meaning: Canonical catalog source identifying a verified same-assessment version group; otherwise source_id.

adjudicated_disposition.meaning: Independent source-level classification; distinct from verified exposure or paper-wide validity.

adjudication_evidence.meaning: Evidence supporting source eligibility, classification and any version equivalence.

adjudication_locator.meaning: Document/page/section references supporting independent source adjudication.

adjudication_limitations.meaning: Unresolved evidence or limits to source-level adjudication.

source_ids.meaning: Semicolon-separated source listings in a verified version group.

catalog_entries.meaning: Number of catalog listings in a source-assessment unit.

disposition.meaning: Adjudicated source-assessment category; empty if unresolved.

adjudication_conflict.meaning: yes if resolved reviewers assign inconsistent dispositions to purported versions.

limitations.meaning: Scope limits of the source adjudication.

adjudication_date.meaning: Date the source evidence was adjudicated; not public disclosure date.

indexed_publication_date.meaning: OpenAlex indexed original-publication date, preserved separately from publisher metadata.

indexed_publication_year.meaning: OpenAlex publication year used symmetrically for treated/control cohort retrieval and matching.

publication_date_source.meaning: Publisher metadata URL supporting the conservative article-age date; empty when unresolved.

metadata_provenance.csv.unit: accepted bibliographic provider response for an identity

source_units.csv.unit: catalog source-equivalence group, not necessarily one independent article assessment
